attributes.board_name: Vermont Board of Veterinary Medicine (Office of Professional Regulation)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Relevant, evidence-based learning that improves the licensee's own practice: courses, peer interaction, reading, research, presentations, curriculum development; no express approval needed
rules.audit_note: Keep certificates and a contemporaneous log of non-course activities for 4 years; Board may audit any time.
rules.legal_basis: Vermont Administrative Rules for Veterinarians, Rule 6-1; 26 V.S.A. chapter 44
rules.notes: At least 24 hours per fixed two-year licensing period, attested at renewal; a log form is on the Board website. Where rules require in-person CE, synchronous live virtual counts (H.305, 2023).
rules.rule_quote: In each biennial licensing period, a licensee shall devote at least 24 hours to such pursuits and shall attest to having done so as a condition of renewal.
